# RELEASE


## DETAILS


## Uniti again recognized for its focus on hiring military veterans


November 16, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.uniti.com/node/17041/pdf)


LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Uniti (NASDAQ: UNIT), a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States, has again been recognized by the U.S. Department of Labor, the Military Friendly® program, and the Military Times’ Best for Vets program for its initiatives to recruit, employ and retain military veterans.


“Uniti is proud that our dedication to hiring and retaining military veterans have been recognized,” said Jennifer Ragsdale, executive vice president, chief administrative officer and chief people officer at Uniti. “Veterans and their spouses play a critical role in carrying out our mission to deliver essential communications services to our residential, enterprise and wholesale customers.”


Uniti received a platinum[2026 HIRE Vets Medallion Program Award](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JXe2fzfs07HWEgxIunBJn_9w7tHcm4vqpnLEJta7CSy9Wp4sQAel1X7ahkYuxTatxRaf60suHdVv8F52rjoUTNWlCxS_UK25tg3jo8wnKpuiGZ_Z52uWpdzSDW7xGcFFDUiLyC9212tR_Vwh6lzgD-4jGyufuAcrlhUPDghhejOb4f4sU646Anm9r64wHg81IJ8ET1YtMEpdXHSTqAg6K3-xGA-kpwSL-OTKwtR5OJ4=) from the Labor Department. This is the ninth year that the company has been recognized by the HIRE Vets program and the sixth year it has received a platinum medallion.


For more information about the HIRE Vets Medallion Program, please visit[www.hirevets.gov](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qyIrHthNNxfW0lSgCzoyDeAy6IwjsN723Ks8dZxEAesRhdE0C0bGGehzImcMOTBX3f7_2XczlbUml5SkW0PRIbew33IzieYY2dqNAlRh4jf5LJz8KYxccjRtXKRThtH3KOx8Jmtk5beWbu9qlAex5MNq6DwPcyeBwyqo88pQi4VzDVE6FaR6mC_j3JQHPRqbFGdfjb87lKjElvXjdRmpEPeKNpI0HTITFxoLo96BD1jCCD_zsL1fgTNx4S5hPZjiXyrAaiCwuWLbSyot4J14c3Tltboz05htPhE2_RETbQzZZYk6AZoXorRFzTI3f-wplS4eKLJu4uX-cDq-AiVG7A==) .


Uniti ranked first on the[Military Spouse Friendly list](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YGSeEYht3GxYQLovzI5Erb-0EnPSNuZ_oV6H4nEBbqdlzGj8najVqFy64Xkcg97q4gHtXi1F2XVdl2DP7MNDOTfmMWB6wjNi8RsX1CwEQSZL1blMFC7CezdCf078CO2n) and fourth on the[Military Friendly Employer](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YGSeEYht3GxYQLovzI5Erf-4KmADa1mBjsw8l278FqgKJ3RIpJ9lx9dK8rFzWufzUNNaLmoN7m3vfCAXyXJkXWF2yeXGcERHNqZGdCDpC90guUbU6lUuBmQmecoHOXoL) list for companies with annual revenue of $1 billion to $5 billion.


Institutions earning the Military Friendly® Employers designation were evaluated using both public data sources and responses from a proprietary survey. Over 1,200 companies participated in the Military Friendly® survey.


Methodology, criteria, and weightings were determined by VIQTORY with input from the Military Friendly® Advisory Council of independent leaders in the military recruitment community. Final ratings were determined by combining an organization’s survey score with an assessment of the organization’s ability to meet thresholds for Recruitment, New Hire Retention, Employee Turnover, and Promotion and Advancement of veterans and military employees.


Uniti will be showcased in the[2027](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Pf4PjUPP-BBr5s4rgrVH1yiOxHK6ai1ghxCg5NJaMe-XHzaP9IodCymMbKBQKROR-Aa1tru3oqXO3TlZiIYgzA==)[Military Friendly®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=FAMeMy4agwWM9IoiItU-QdkL2HtBRQEeEkfYneMSxYwzoyJFxNzH4aHlptcUjjZn4BkXKEscuLYtMpk3QRTIHG86mn2K_WvzbA5F1HirzYw=) Employers in the Winter issue of[G.I. Jobs®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=k_erdYaM4VH3x19B8NfeDujbIgnH0UfNZX4K9kH7XBU5k4q2fv7LtUBDZqiEnYUDmDf2rguClUEpm5kKqEHZjQ==) magazine and on MilitaryFriendly.com.


Uniti made the Military Times Best for Vets: Employers list for the tenth time in 2026.


The full list of this year’s Best for Vets: Employers rankings is available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RvvyZi9BEFgoONw8ZIEvow9-URJ0_E1yBr-eEKzviKGhjFqaRjf7w0NVE5B5gM-0wb_wGs0g_Ew3qbq9OsTplxW_J6AnlaQFfD29Uk4muGU06EFt6sssiU_zGC6a5x3j) .


The Military Times “Best for Vets: Employers” survey instrument and scoring rubric have been honed and developed in consultation with veterans and subject matter experts to identify the paramount support that companies should provide to active-duty and veteran service members.


The survey captures the areas of greatest importance to transitioning service members, veterans, and their families when looking for an employer. Recruitment and employment practices, as well as retention and support programs, were given the most weight and importance in scoring and final rankings.


To see available jobs at Uniti, please visit our[careers site](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PznE3ppvGwt4DHAlrfQpiTKJxpEf_Uku0iMsGeYKOXJ5cydF4gxR6V7d1-IbghXHm_YKDTl7QIvBr0N5PAy7pa_C8I0fHQxnHZwRTYOl_rY=) .
